senses.gloss: f. pl. (צְלֵי I) dates dried or to be dried.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3:17">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ</cite> <he>והוה ליה דבש דצ׳</he> and he had (and gave them by mistake) date-honey (in place of bees’ honey).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:24">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>דשטח צַלְיָן וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M01844"><he>מסבסלה</he></cite>.
